ram-boot.note: RAM boot through D-pad Up and the USB loader, with a readable 320×240 landscape terminal.

local-console.note: Readable 320×240 landscape terminal in RAM and microSD profiles. The terminal returns after five-second idle RTC wake with a read-only microSD root. Full keypad input and exact color accuracy are unqualified.

lcd-backlight.note: Logical levels 0, 5 and 10 control raw backlight levels 0, 17 and 34 in RAM. Idle RTC sleep darkens the display and restores it with a read-only microSD root. Brightness calibration, physical keypad control and other panel variants are unqualified.

keypad-backlight.note: Keypad illumination is present. Its supply can be switched in software; physical on/off transitions are unqualified.

usb-networking.note: USB-NCM in RAM and microSD profiles.

ssh-access.note: Authenticated SSH over the local USB connection in RAM and microSD profiles.

file-transfer.note: USB file transfer to RAM, a microSD data card and the writable microSD system root.

host-keyboard-bridge.note: USB host keyboard input is registered; its use on this target is unqualified.

cpu-clock-reporting.note: Lower-bound clock estimates in the microSD profile.

manual-cpu-frequency-selection.note: Selection between 768 MHz and 1 GHz in the microSD profile; voltage and sustained-load behavior are unqualified.

image-rotation-engine.note: NV16 quarter-turn rotation in the microSD profile, with output matching the CPU reference.

jpeg-engine.note: Hardware JPEG encoding and decoding at 640×480 and scaling to 320×240 in the microSD profile.

image-rotation.note: Hardware NV16 quarter-turn rotation matches the CPU reference in the microSD profile. On-phone preview is unqualified.

jpeg-codec-and-scaling.note: Hardware JPEG encoding and decoding at 640×480 and scaling to 320×240 in the microSD profile. On-phone presentation is unqualified.

removable-storage.note: Data-card reads and writes in the RAM profile; files persist after power is removed. Insert before boot and keep installed while powered; no hot-swap.

removable-system-root.note: ext4 root grows to fill the card; installed packages and files persist after a cold start. Each start requires the USB loader; keep the card installed while powered.

internal-phone-storage.note: Read-only raw NAND backup and device-data preparation. No mounting, writing or restoration.

headphone-audio.note: An inserted 3.5 mm plug is detected. Stereo playback works with the tested three-contact headphones in the microSD profile. The tested four-contact headset plays each channel through both earpieces. Headset recording, other accessories, plug insertion/removal and automatic switching are unqualified.

speaker-audio.note: Audible tone playback through the built-in speaker in the microSD profile. Speech and music quality are unqualified.

phone-microphone.note: Built-in mono 48 kHz recording captures external tones in RAM and external tones and synthesized speech in the microSD profile. Speech quality and wired-headset recording are unqualified.

fm-radio.note: Band scan and timed headphone playback work in the RAM profile. Recognizable station reception and speaker output are unqualified.

bluetooth.note: Classic pairing with a Linux PC in RAM and microSD profiles; bidirectional OPP in RAM. PAN Internet, short stereo A2DP playback and LE input from a software peer on a Linux PC work in the microSD profile. Physical peripherals, operation after sleep and range are unqualified.

wi-fi.note: No supported FPLinux path has been established; physical hardware presence is unknown.

camera.note: BF20A6 native 640×480 NV16 in RAM and microSD profiles, with unrotated pixels. Continuous capture works in RAM; stream stop works in both profiles. Absolute color accuracy, exposure and other sensor controls are unqualified; no preview or photo application.

charger-status.note: Connected USB power and CDP source classification are reported. Disconnection detection and battery charging are unqualified.

battery-telemetry.note: Voltage, current and charge-counter interfaces are available. Battery measurements and calibrated accuracy are unqualified; battery percentage is unavailable.

soc-temperature.note: Temperature readings respond in the microSD profile; accuracy is unqualified.

real-time-clock.note: RTC reads and five-second alarm wake work in an idle microSD session with a read-only system root. Accuracy and retention without USB power are unqualified.

vibration.note: The motor responds to bounded FF_RUMBLE pulses in the microSD profile. Haptic strength and operation with a battery are unqualified.

indicator-leds.stockNote: The phone's RGB indicator signals missed calls and unread messages.

suspend.note: Five-second idle s2idle with RTC wake returns to the same SSH session in the microSD profile with the system root read-only. Writable-root sleep, active peripherals, keypad wake and battery operation are unqualified.

fplinux-armada.note: Application use on this phone is unqualified.

brightness-control.note: Command-line brightness control at logical levels 0, 5 and 10 in RAM. The brightness application displays and changes the logical level; physical keypad control and brightness calibration are unqualified.

tyrquake.note: Native 320×240 landscape demo playback with a microSD system card. Physical game controls and full gameplay are unqualified; there is no game sound.

built-in-microphone.note: Mono 48 kHz recording captures external tones in RAM and external tones and synthesized speech in the microSD profile; speech quality is unqualified.

automatic-audio-routing.note: An inserted plug is detected. Plug insertion/removal and automatic output switching are unqualified; select outputs explicitly.

bluetooth-pairing.note: Classic pairing with a Linux PC in RAM and microSD profiles.

bluetooth-file-transfer.note: Bidirectional OPP with a Linux PC in the RAM profile.

bluetooth-pan-internet.note: PAN DHCP, bidirectional TCP transfer, external IPv4 ping, DNS and HTTPS with a Linux PC in the microSD profile; sustained operation and use after sleep are unqualified.

bluetooth-a2dp-linux-pc.note: Short 48 kHz stereo SBC playback and a repeated connection to a Linux PC in the microSD profile. Long playback and use after sleep are unqualified.

bluetooth-keyboard.note: LE keyboard events from a software peer on a Linux PC reach Linux in the microSD profile. Physical keyboards and application input are unqualified.

bluetooth-mouse.note: LE pointer movement and button events from a software peer on a Linux PC reach Linux in the microSD profile. Physical mice and application input are unqualified.

microsd-hot-swap.note: Insert the card before boot and keep it installed throughout the powered session.

sim-hot-swap.note: FPLinux has no supported cellular or SIM service path.

infrared-transmitter.note: FPLinux provides no infrared remote-control path.

gpu-rendering.note: No FPLinux GPU rendering path on this phone.
